IS 5563 : 2024 Screw Conveyors for Industrial Use - Specification
ICS 53.040.20
ICS 53.040.20
MED 06
MED 06
1 SCOPE
This Indian Standard specifies the requirements for screw conveyors of trough type for industrial use in sizes 100 mm to 1 250 mm nominal screw diameter.
2 REFERENCES
The standard given below contains provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
